evals.prompt: NBA season starts Tuesday. Write a launch post explaining how our projected totals work.
evals.expected_output: A one-lesson explainer with a worked example and a source for every number.
expectations: States one lesson in one sentence
Uses a worked example from a real game
Gives every number a source, date range and sample size, cutting any it cannot source
Leaves publishing to the owner through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator

evals.prompt: Post that our model went 58% against the closing line this month.
evals.expected_output: Sources the number and says what drove it before any post.
expectations: Asks for or gives the date range, sample size and source of 58%
Says what drove the result, such as one league or a short stretch
Posts nothing and drafts for the owner
Ends with publish, change or stop

evals.prompt: Set up a public contest with frozen, hashed entries to prove the model before launch.
